result.topic_en: Calculations on the degree (order) of powers $\pi^x$ of an element $\pi=\alpha^r\beta^s$ built from two elements of coprime degrees, determining the degree via greatest common divisors of rational numbers and finding conditions for common elements of the classes generated by $\pi$ and $\pi_1$.
result.transcription:
[-...-] $\pi = \alpha^r\beta^s$ ; [-...-] $A=[\alpha]$, $B=[\beta]$, $A-B=1$ ;
$\pi^x = \alpha^{rx}\beta^{sx}$ ; Grad $p$ bestimmt durch $\frac{1}{p} = [1, \frac{r}{a}, \frac{s}{b}]$ \quad $(1,A)=a$, $(1,B)=b$
[-...-]
$\pi_1 = \alpha^{r_1}\beta^{s_1}$ ; $\frac{1}{p_1} = [1, \frac{r_1}{a}, \frac{s_1}{b}]$ ;
Gemeinsame Elemente $\pi^x = \pi_1^{x_1}$ ; $\alpha^{rx} = \alpha^{r_1x_1}$ , $\beta^{sx} = \beta^{s_1x_1}$
$rx \equiv r_1x_1$ (mod. $a$) \quad $\frac{r}{a}x - \frac{r_1}{a}x_1 \equiv 0$
$sx \equiv s_1x_1$ (mod. $b$) \quad $\frac{s}{b}x - \frac{s_1}{b}x_1 \equiv 0$ \quad mod. 1
$x \equiv 0$
$x_1 \equiv 0$
$\frac{r_1}{a}h + \frac{s_1}{b}k + l = \frac{1}{p_1}$ ; $[h,k,l] = [1]$
$\frac{r}{a}h + \frac{s}{b}k = \frac{m}{p}$
$\frac{m}{p}x - \frac{x_1}{p_1} \equiv 0$
$\frac{r}{a}x - \frac{r_1p_1}{a}\cdot\frac{m}{p}x \equiv 0$
$\frac{s}{b}x - \frac{s_1p_1}{b}\cdot\frac{m}{p}x \equiv 0$
$[\frac{rs_1 - sr_1}{ab}, \frac{r}{a}, \frac{s}{b}, \frac{r_1}{a}, \frac{s_1}{b}, 1] = \frac{1}{q}$
$\tau =$
$x\tau_1 + y(\varrho\tau_1 - \varrho_1 m\tau)$
$+ z(\sigma\tau_1 - \sigma_1 m\tau)$
$= (x + y\varrho + z\sigma)\tau_1$
$-(y\varrho_1 + z\sigma_1)m\tau$
$y = \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}x_1$, $z = -\frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}x_1$
$x\tau_1 + x_1(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1)$
$\varrho x \equiv \varrho_1 x_1$ \quad $h\varrho_1 + k\sigma_1 + l = \frac{1}{p_1}$ \quad $\varrho$ \quad $\sigma$
$\sigma x \equiv \sigma_1 x_1$ \quad $h\varrho + k\sigma = \frac{m}{p}$ \quad $-\varrho_1$ \quad $-\sigma_1$
$x \equiv 0$
$0 \equiv x_1$
$\frac{m}{p}x \equiv \frac{x_1}{p_1}$ ; $\varrho x \equiv \varrho_1 p_1 \cdot \frac{m}{p}x$ ; $\sigma x \equiv \sigma_1 p_1\cdot\frac{m}{p}x$ ; $x \equiv 0$
$x[1, \varrho - \varrho_1\frac{mp_1}{p}, \sigma - \sigma_1\frac{mp_1}{p}] > [1]$
$p\varrho = u$, $p\sigma = v$, $p.1 = p$
$p_1\varrho_1 = u_1$, $p_1\sigma_1 = v_1$, $p_1.1 = p_1$
$[u,v,p] = 1$
$\frac{\varrho}{p_1} - \frac{m\varrho_1}{p} = k(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1) + l\varrho$ ; $\frac{\sigma}{p_1} - \frac{m\sigma_1}{p} = -h(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1) + l\sigma$
$\varrho - \varrho_1\frac{mp_1}{p} = kp_1(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1) + l\varrho p_1$ ; $\sigma - \sigma_1\frac{mp_1}{p} = -hp_1(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1) + l\sigma p_1$ \quad $[u_1, v_1, p_1] = 1$

$\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1 = (\varrho - \varrho_1\frac{mp_1}{p})\sigma_1 - (\sigma - \sigma_1\frac{mp_1}{p})\varrho_1 = (k\sigma_1 + h\varrho_1)p_1(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1) + lp_1(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1)$
$[\varrho, \sigma, 1] = \tau$ ; $[\varrho_1, \sigma_1, 1] = \tau_1$ ; $\tau = \frac{1}{p}$, $\tau_1 = \frac{1}{p_1}$ ; $1 = \tau\tau_1\tau_2 p_2$ ; $\tau_2 p_2 = pp_1$
$[\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1, \varrho, \sigma, \varrho_1, \sigma_1, 1] = \tau\tau_1\tau_2$ ; $\tau_2$ ganz ; $= [\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1, \tau, \tau_1] =$ [-...-]
$h\varrho_1 + k\sigma_1 + l = \tau_1$ ; $[h,k,l] = 1$
$h\varrho + k\sigma = m\tau$ ; $m$ ganz
$[uv_1 - vu_1, up_1, vp_1, pu_1, pv_1, pp_1]$
$= \tau_2 = [uv_1 - vu_1, p, p_1]$
$m\tau x \equiv \tau_1 x_1$ ; $\varrho x \equiv \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}m\tau x$ ; $\sigma x \equiv \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}m\tau x$ ;
$x \equiv 0$ ; $x(\varrho - \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}m\tau) \equiv 0$ ; $x(\sigma - \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}m\tau) \equiv 0$
$x[1, \varrho - \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}m\tau, \sigma - \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}m\tau] \equiv 0$ ; $(\varrho - \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}m\tau)\frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1} - (\sigma - \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}m\tau)\frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1} = \frac{\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1}{\tau_1} = \tau\tau_2\delta$
$\delta$ ganz.
$\varrho\tau_1 - \varrho_1 m\tau = k(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1) + l\varrho = k\tau\tau_1\tau_2\delta + l\varrho$
$\sigma\tau_1 - \sigma_1 m\tau = -h(\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1) + l\sigma = -h\tau\tau_1\tau_2\delta + l\sigma$
$\varrho - \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}m\tau = \varrho'\tau$ \quad $\varrho'$, $\sigma'$ ganz
$\sigma - \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}m\tau = \sigma'\tau$
[-$m\tau = h\varrho + k\sigma$-]
$\tau_1 = h\varrho_1 + k\sigma_1 + l$
$h(\varrho - \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}m\tau) + k(\sigma - \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}m\tau) = m\tau - \frac{\tau_1 - l}{\tau_1}m\tau = \frac{l}{\tau_1}m\tau$
$\tau(h\varrho' + k\sigma') = \frac{l}{\tau_1}m\tau$
$h\varrho' + k\sigma' = \frac{l}{\tau_1}m = l\frac{1}{\tau_1}m$
$[\tau_1, \varrho\tau_1 - \varrho_1 m\tau, \sigma\tau_1 - \sigma_1 m\tau] > \tau\tau_1\tau_2$
Umgekehrt ist
$\varrho\sigma_1 - \sigma\varrho_1 = (\varrho\tau_1 - \varrho_1 m\tau)\frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1} - (\sigma\tau_1 - \sigma_1 m\tau)\frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}$ ; $1 = \frac{1}{\tau_1}\cdot\tau_1$ ; $\varrho_1 = \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}\cdot\tau_1$ ; $\sigma_1 = \frac{\sigma_1}{\tau_1}\cdot\tau_1$
$\varrho = \frac{1}{\tau_1}(\varrho\tau_1 - \varrho_1 m\tau) + \frac{\varrho_1}{\tau_1}m\tau$

methods.what: Degree of $\pi=\alpha^r\beta^s$ given by reciprocal of gcd of rationals
Reduction of common elements $\pi^x=\pi_1^{x_1}$ to simultaneous congruences mod 1
Bezout-type representation of the gcd $\tau_1$ with integer coefficients
gcd of the determinant and entries expressed as $\tau\tau_1\tau_2$ with integer $\tau_2$
Condition on $x$ as divisibility by a gcd of three numbers
Divisibility of the gcd by $\tau\tau_1\tau_2$ and the converse expression
